name: simplicial_pair_disagreement
rule: (2 + weight/max(1e-9,weight+neighbor_weight)) if (weight >= neighbor_peak and 2*neighbor_edge_count == neighbor_count*(neighbor_count-1)) else (weight/max(1e-9,weight+max(neighbor_peak,neighbor_weight-2*neighbor_pair_weight/max(1e-9,neighbor_weight))) + 0.05*weight/max(1e-9,weight+neighbor_weight))
rationale: Replace residual packing and covering lookahead with a local pair-disagreement price. Discount neighbor mass by twice its conflicting weight-product sum divided by its total weight, and floor the estimated opportunity cost at the heaviest neighbor. This price equals total neighbor weight for an independent neighborhood and its maximum weight for a clique. Prioritize roots whose available neighbors form a clique and whose weight dominates every neighbor: an optimum can include such a root by a one-vertex exchange. Otherwise use a weight-to-price ratio with a small preference for lower closed-neighborhood mass. Every structural feature uses only available neighbors.
